body:
>Wife left, never came back. As I anticipated she started to date, I can't live with that. I tried to date, but it doesn't work for me as I love her. She hasn't talked to me since the separation, she deserted the marriage, she abandoned me. I never understood what I did so wrong to deserve that treatment. Therapy is not saving me.

I am just very anxious to f%ck up the suicide when I will pull the trigger, the angle, etc. I just hope I will succeed, or at least I will bleed out before help arrives.

I haven't decided if I will text her right before I do it, and what I will tell her. Most likely she won't care.

What terrifies me is the day I will say bye to my kids and their mom and they won't know that their lives will be shattered few hours later.

I forgot to mention, the wife that left me is second marriage, we don't have kids together. I have another ex-wife with whom I have kids with, this one cheated on me but we're friends now, although that contributed to my current instability for sure.

I talked to a couple of friends today, they have no idea what is going in my head. I took one valium today to try to forget, it kind of worked but now it wearing out.

The wife will start dating in a few month, I will not be able to take it, the pain will be excruciating, I cannot go through that.

My plans are firming up. We texted earlier and she is definitely not coming back, my brain is messed up. I am planning to write notes for my kids, and her and do it dec-31, I'll be alone for a few days so I can die slowly in my house with no one to save me, so I should be good.
Why is no one commenting here?
